_comment: Phase 10 active-campaign definition. Edit this file to retune the campaign -- no code changes needed. This does not expand or switch markets automatically: adding a second campaign later means adding a new entry here and code to pick between them, not changing this one's geo_fence.

active_campaign.name: jacksonville_duval_2026
active_campaign._dates_comment: Decision/review dates are informational bookkeeping only -- nothing in this pipeline auto-disables the campaign on review_date. A human decides whether to continue, adjust, or retire it.

geo_fence._comment: Real geographic fields, not 'Jacksonville' text matching (the city 'Jacksonville' also exists outside Florida, and several incorporated Duval-adjacent beach towns -- Atlantic Beach, Neptune Beach, Jacksonville Beach, Baldwin -- don't contain the word 'Jacksonville' at all). An explicit county column from an external source (PropWire almost always includes one) is checked FIRST and is authoritative; the ZIP list below is only the fallback when no county field is present.
geo_fence._zip_known_gap: Best-effort list assembled from public county/ZIP references, not an authoritative USPS/Census crosswalk fetch (that lookup was blocked in this environment -- see README Phase 10 'known gap'). A few genuinely boundary-straddling ZIPs (e.g. 32082 Ponte Vedra Beach, 32259 Fruit Cove) are deliberately left OFF this list because they're predominantly St. Johns County, not Duval -- if a real Duval parcel legitimately uses one of those, it will be misclassified out_of_market and needs a manual add here. Verify against the county field whenever the source provides one instead of relying on this list alone.

active_campaign._property_type_comment: Campaign focus is single-family houses specifically (DOR prefix '01'), narrower than Phase 2's broader 'include' set (which also includes vacant residential land, prefix '00'). This only gates the new campaign_eligibility field -- it does not change Phase 2's own property_type_decision or exclude vacant land from the rest of the pipeline.
active_campaign._tenure_comment: Ownership/acquisition tenure, computed dynamically against the run date from the latest non-ambiguous recorded transfer -- never the property's construction year. See compute_tenure_priority() in duval_leads_db.py.
